student_warning.subject: Attendance Check-in – {{firstName}} {{lastName}}
body: This is a friendly check-in about your attendance. At Pukekohe High School we want to support you to be successful, and regular attendance is a key part of that (Manaakitanga).
Subjects with the lowest attendance in this report:
If there’s anything getting in the way of you being at school, please talk with your teacher, form teacher, or Dean. We can work together to support you (Kotahitanga).
We know you can make positive choices from here (Arahitanga), and consistency will make a real difference (Pūmau(tanga)).

parent_inform.subject: Attendance Update – {{firstName}} {{lastName}} ({{studentId}})
body: We are getting in touch to let you know that {{firstName}} {{lastName}}’s attendance is currently a concern. At Pukekohe High School, we aim to support every student to succeed through care, partnership and consistency (Manaakitanga, Kotahitanga, Pūmau(tanga)).
Subjects with the lowest attendance in this report:

Regular attendance is important for learning progress and wellbeing. If there are circumstances affecting attendance, please reply to this email or contact the school so we can work together to support your child (Kotahitanga).
Thank you for helping us reinforce positive routines and commitment to learning (Pūmau(tanga)).
